header: Label and value pairs, with room for a caveat
lead: Attributes of one subject rather than rows of a data set, which is why this is a description list and not a table. The editor fills pairs and never types a header row.
caption: The caption line names the subject and the conditions the figures hold under
note: Use Captioned Data Table when the rows form a data set with a source, and Comparison Matrix when two options are being weighed against each other.

rows.title: Minimum rows
rows.text: One pair is a sentence, not a specification.

rows.title: Maximum rows
rows.text: Past forty, a reader stops reading and starts searching.

rows.title: The caveat line
rows.text: It sits under both columns and stays part of the pair.

rows.title: Below 480px
rows.text: A value set right against a long term leaves two words a line.
